summary: This is a DSH model routing plugin that forwards requests through the currently configured supplier for each model and provides per-model provider ordering and switching controls in the UI settings.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This plugin is primarily an LLM-model routing utility: it creates a virtual provider that merges configured providers/models and forwards each request to the currently selected provider for that model, with settings and UI controls for per-model provider ordering and switching. It also persists routing configuration for both web and headless profiles, so the user-facing goal is model-provider management and request delegation, not development tooling or content generation.
